title: Shalik 1.1.1 - Architectural Modeling Suite for Rhino 8 & 9
changelog: Full compatibility with both Rhino 8 and Rhino 9 (Windows x64)
Unified installer (Shalik-Setup.exe) automatically detects and installs into Rhino 8, Rhino 9, or both
Bundled Tree Generator 3D model library (Source.3dm) inside installer and package
Automatic toolbar, registry, and double-click edit registration for Rhino 8 & Rhino 9
